description: This file defines a ConsumerProcessor class that consumes frames from a ProducerProcessor's queue, processes lifecycle frames (Start, End, Cancel), and handles frame transformation and forwarding in an asynchronous context.

classes.name: ConsumerProcessor
classes.description: A frame processor that consumes frames from a ProducerProcessor's queue, handling lifecycle events and frame transformation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ConsumerProcessor with a producer, transformer, and direction.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling start, end, and cancel events, and pushes frames downstream.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Starts the consumer task and registers with the producer.

methods.name: _consumer_task_handler
methods.description: Asynchronous handler that consumes frames from the producer queue, transforms, and forwards them.
